claim.value: Missing entries, unsupported intervals and missing coverage should remain explicit alongside supported sequences.
claim.scope: Representation of evidential gaps in the investigation; no events are inferred merely to fill those gaps.

provenance.rationale: P008 and P019 explicitly require preserving and reporting gaps alongside supported sequences; P030 supports restraint about inferring events from absent entries.

signal_basis.value: The investigation encounters missing entries, unsupported intervals or missing coverage while assembling booking timelines and recording supported sequences.
signal_basis.scope: The completeness and evidential support of the reconstructed booking timelines.

provenance.rationale: These spans specify timeline assembly and explicit retention of missing or unsupported portions alongside supported sequences.
The bounded evidential-recording claim requires no unresolved empirical relation.

rationale: Observed gaps warrant representing those gaps explicitly so the record preserves the distinction between supported sequences and unknown intervals. This licenses the specified recording practice without establishing what occurred during the gaps or what caused lateness.
uncertainty: The underlying events may remain unknown; that uncertainty does not undermine the warrant for recording the gaps.
